expected: An unmeasured gain of approximately +1–3 percentage points all-pass; the main risk is that the additional audit distracts Luna from a correct, focused repair and introduces regressions.
hypothesis: Requiring Luna to verify the completed repair against every numbered requirement will reduce incomplete repairs and improve hidden all-pass over the incumbent.
mechanism: Change only the final repair prompt. After fixing supported findings, Luna must audit the resulting file against the actual specification and correct any additional established violations. This targets the remaining generation-and-repair failures while preserving the incumbent’s sampling, reviewer, selection, and call allocation.
